title: Trace
description: A recorded decision, with exactly what SSoR showed the decision-maker. Recorded BEFORE any action is requested: the trace id travels to DSoR as a correlation id, and DSoR's evidence returns linked to it. Nothing in a trace is edited afterwards.

id.description: Server-assigned trace id, returned at record time. Used as the correlation id when acting through DSoR.

decisionContext.description: Server-issued context grouping every read made for this decision (see decision-context.json).

principal.description: The deciding principal — a worker or a person.

justification.description: The decision-maker's own statement. An attributed claim: NOT proof of internal reasoning, nor of inputs read outside SSoR.

citedReceipts.description: Receipts this decision-maker claims to rely on. A subset of receiptsAttached — selective citation is visible to a reviewer.

receiptsAttached.description: EVERY receipt issued in the decision context, attached by SSoR at record time. The agent cannot remove these, invent one, or misquote one.

externalRefs.description: Anything read outside SSoR and kept: DSoR response references (dsor:read/...), KSoR citations.

policy.description: Policy versions in force at decision time (README §What a trace records).

controlVersions.description: DSoR control versions the worker expects to be enforced — pairing with ksorGeneration exposes KSoR↔DSoR drift (issue #7).

action.description: What the decision will request from DSoR, if anything. Omitted when the decision is to take no action.

outcome.description: Filled when DSoR's evidence for this trace arrives — appended, never edited. Absent means no outcome has been recorded yet.
